requirement: Validate an add-metric-rule command: the metric and criterion IDs must not be empty, exactly one of the score function and major/minor flag must be set, and a supplied score function must satisfy the recursive formula rules.

preconditions.text: Validation runs on an in-memory command without database access
A score function is supplied and must satisfy the formula rules

inputs.text: Scoring rule with the constant score function 1
Scoring rule whose score function is a bare variable reference
Scoring rule with a nested ternary age-band formula
Valid command with a version-7 metric and criterion ID
Valid command with GUID ffffffff-ffff-ffff-ffff-ffffffffffff (maximum boundary)
Guid.Empty as the clinical metric ID
Command that sets both a score function and IsMajor
Command that sets neither a score function nor IsMajor
Score function with no fields at all
Binary formula with a left operand and operator but no right operand
Score function referencing Guid.Empty as the variable
Binary formula with operator 999 (outside every defined member)
Empty metric and criterion IDs with neither score function nor flag

returns.text: Single validation error reported on ClinicalMetricId or CriterionId
Single error on the command itself for the exclusivity rule
Single error reported on ScoreFunction for an unusable formula
Three violations reported for the empty IDs and the exclusivity rule

exception_text: No unhandled exception; invalid input is reported as validation errors
